hull.purpose: Team totals in the lockup. Kanit_800ExtraBold_Italic, tabular numerals, capped at 1.2x dynamic type and shrunk to fit.

title.purpose: Target value, team name field, sheet titles, empty-state heading, winner sentence. Kanit_800ExtraBold_Italic, uppercase.

button.purpose: Slab button labels, team names on liveries, points in row chips. Kanit_800ExtraBold_Italic, uppercase.

body.purpose: Full sentences only: explanations, errors, snackbar message. Kanit_500Medium, upright.

label.purpose: Field labels, points remaining, rounds chip, hand numbers. Kanit_600SemiBold_Italic, uppercase, tabular numerals.

motion.name: ease-out-exp
motion.purpose: CSS equivalent of Easing.out(Easing.exp), the easing of every authored animation.

motion.name: row-enter
motion.value: 200ms translateX from -56 (team A) or 56 (team B) to 0
motion.purpose: A new hand streaks in from its team's side.

motion.name: total-pop
motion.purpose: A team total snaps when it changes.

motion.name: winner-flood
motion.value: 220ms translateX from 1.6 screen widths on the winner's side to 0
motion.purpose: The winning colour floods the screen.

motion.name: press-shift
motion.purpose: Pressed state of slab buttons and the target slab (target slab opacity 0.6).

motion.name: reduce-motion
motion.purpose: Row entrance, total pop, winner flood and list scrolling cut to their end state; the sheet slide and winner-screen fade are skipped.

motion.name: modal-transitions
motion.purpose: System modal transitions, set to none under Reduce Motion.

shape.renderer: react-native-svg path; skew transforms are not used because Android does not render them

components.name: Slab Button, Team A
components.description: Filled team slab for quick points and confirming a hand. Shifts 3 points right when pressed.
components.css: .ds-slab-a { font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0; background: #FF5A00; color: #0E1114; clip-path: polygon(12px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 12px) 100%, 0 100%); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 200ms; } .ds-slab-a:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-slab-a:active { transform: translateX(3px); opacity: 0.78; } .ds-slab-a:focus-visible { outline: none; opacity: 0.9; transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-slab-a:disabled { background: #2A2F36; color: #B6BCC4; transform: none; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Slab Button, Team B
components.description: The same slab in team B's colour.
components.css: .ds-slab-b { font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0; background: #DFFF00; color: #0E1114; clip-path: polygon(12px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 12px) 100%, 0 100%); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 200ms; } .ds-slab-b:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-slab-b:active { transform: translateX(3px); opacity: 0.78; } .ds-slab-b:focus-visible { outline: none; opacity: 0.9; transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-slab-b:disabled { background: #2A2F36; color: #B6BCC4; transform: none; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Slab Button, Outlined
components.description: Cancel action: ground interior inside a 2-point line outline.
components.css: .ds-slab-outline { position: relative; font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0; background: #6B7480; color: #FFFFFF; clip-path: polygon(12px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 12px) 100%, 0 100%); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 200ms; } .ds-slab-outline::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2px 2.2px; background: #0E1114; clip-path: polygon(11.5px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 11.5px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-slab-outline span { position: relative; } .ds-slab-outline:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-slab-outline:active, .ds-slab-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; transform: translateX(3px); opacity: 0.78; }

components.name: Livery Lockup
components.description: Both team panels meeting on a diagonal seam; each panel is a button that opens the points sheet.
components.css: .ds-lockup { display: flex; gap: 6px; width: 360px; background: #0E1114; overflow: hidden; } .ds-livery { flex: 1; min-height: 172px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px; border: none; border-radius: 0; color: #0E1114; text-align: left; font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; transition: opacity 200ms; } .ds-livery-a { background: #FF5A00; padding: 16px 40px 16px 16px; margin-right: -18px; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 36px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-livery-b { background: #DFFF00; padding: 16px 16px 16px 48px; margin-left: -18px; clip-path: polygon(36px 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-livery:hover, .ds-livery:focus-visible { outline: none; opacity: 0.9; } .ds-livery:active { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-livery-name { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-livery-total { font-size: 76px; line-height: 1.05; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-livery-left { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-rounds { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 12px; background: #0E1114; clip-path: polygon(5px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 5px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-rounds-a { color: #FF5A00; } .ds-rounds-b { color: #DFFF00; }

components.name: Score Row
components.description: One hand: points chip under the scoring team, hand number between the columns, delete floating at the right edge.
components.html: 45010
components.css: .ds-row { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 328px; min-height: 52px; background: #1A1E23; clip-path: polygon(11px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 11px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-row-cell { flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: center; } .ds-points { font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 20px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; min-width: 40px; text-align: center; padding: 4px 12px; background: #FF5A00; color: #0E1114; clip-path: polygon(8px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 8px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-row-zero { font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 20px; color: #B6BCC4; } .ds-row-hand { font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 13px; width: 44px; text-align: center; color: #B6BCC4; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row-delete { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: none; border: none; color: #B6BCC4; } .ds-row-delete:hover, .ds-row-delete:focus-visible { outline: none; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-row-delete:active { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Number Field
components.description: Rectangular numeric field with its label above; the border turns to the danger colour when the value is invalid.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 312px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 13px; color: #B6BCC4; } .ds-field-input { font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; font-size: 44px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; min-height: 76px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #1A1E23; color: #FFFFFF; border: 2px solid #6B7480; border-radius: 0; caret-color: #FF5A00; outline: none; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #B6BCC4; } .ds-field-input:hover, .ds-field-input:focus-visible { border-color: #B6BCC4; } .ds-field-input:invalid { border-color: #FF6B5C; }

components.name: Target Slab
components.description: Outlined header slab showing the score that wins the match; tap to edit.
components.css: .ds-target { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0; background: #6B7480; clip-path: polygon(10px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 0 100%); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 200ms; } .ds-target::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2px 2.2px; background: #0E1114; clip-path: polygon(9.6px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 9.6px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-target span { position: relative; } .ds-target-label { font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 16px; color: #B6BCC4; } .ds-target-value { font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; font-size: 28px; color: #FFFFFF; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-target:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-target:active, .ds-target:focus-visible { outline: none; transform: translateX(3px); opacity: 0.6; }

components.css: .ds-winner { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; width: 344px; padding: 24px 8px; background: #FF5A00; font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-winner-slab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 24px 40px 12px; background: #0E1114; color: #FF5A00; clip-path: polygon(37px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 37px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-winner-name { font-size: 20px; } .ds-winner-total { font-size: 132px; line-height: 140px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-winner-other { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 8px 32px; background: #0E1114; color: #0E1114; clip-path: polygon(16px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 16px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-winner-other::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2px 2.2px; background: #FF5A00; clip-path: polygon(15.6px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 15.6px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-winner-other span { position: relative; } .ds-winner-other-total { font-size: 56px; line-height: 62px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-slashes { display: inline-flex; gap: 1px; } .ds-slashes i { display: block; width: 11px; height: 18px; background: #FF5A00; clip-path: polygon(3.8px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 3.8px) 100%, 0 100%); }

narrative.overview:
The scoreboard is painted like two rival race cars parked nose to nose. Each team owns a flood of one loud colour with its total set in numerals large enough to read from the far seat at the table, and every other surface steps back to graphite at night or pit silver by day. There is one screen, and its three overlays (points sheet, value sheet, winner screen) are built from the same parts.

The system has one shape and one typeface. The shape is a parallelogram that leans 12 degrees forward, used for buttons, rows, chips, the two liveries and the full-screen winner flood. The typeface is Kanit, set in heavy italic capitals for everything that is a name, a number or a command, and in upright medium only for full sentences. The only ornament is a mark of three small leaning bars cut from the same shape.

Density is low and the targets are large: the smallest control is 48 points, slab buttons are 56 points tall, and the screen carries no navigation, no cards and no icons beyond three small utility symbols.
keyCharacteristics: Two saturated team colours used as fills, always carrying graphite ink.
One forward-leaning parallelogram as the shape of every filled element; zero corner radius anywhere.
Kanit extra-bold italic capitals with tabular numerals; hull-sized totals at 76 points.
Flat tonal layering on a single ground colour per appearance.
Horizontal motion only, 200 to 220 ms, exponential ease-out, removed under Reduce Motion.

rules.name: The Livery Rule
rules.body: A team colour is a fill. It carries Graphite Ink and never prints as text on the ground or on a surface.

rules.name: The Graphite Exception Rule
rules.body: A team colour prints as text only on a Graphite Ink fill: the rounds chip inside each livery and the winner's slab on the winner screen.

rules.name: The Same Ink Rule
rules.body: Ink on a team colour is #0E1114 in both appearances. It does not invert when the ground does.

rules.name: The Caps Italic Rule
rules.body: Names, numbers and commands are italic capitals. Upright sentence case is reserved for full sentences: explanations, hints, errors and the snackbar message.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every numeral that can change is set with tabular figures so totals and columns do not shift as they update.

rules.name: The Hull Cap Rule
rules.body: Text follows the system font size up to 1.6 times. Hull numerals, the winner heading, both winner-screen totals and the number field stop at 1.2 times, and hull numerals, the winner's total and button labels shrink to fit one line, so a total never truncates.

rules.name: The Tonal Step Rule
rules.body: A surface is distinguished from what is beneath it by stepping one neutral tone, never by a shadow or a gradient. The newest row is marked by moving from Surface to Raised Surface.

rules.name: The Lean Rule
rules.body: Every filled shape is the 12-degree parallelogram, drawn as a path. Do not reach for a skew transform, a rotated view or a rounded rectangle.

rules.name: The One Ornament Rule
rules.body: The triple-slash mark is the only decoration. It is hidden from assistive technology.

dos: Do draw every filled shape as the 12-degree parallelogram path (offset = height × 0.2126), leaning the same way as the italic type.
Do put Graphite Ink (#0E1114) on Safety Orange and Acid Yellow in both appearances.
Do set names, numbers and commands in Kanit italic capitals, and keep upright sentence case for full sentences.
Do use tabular numerals for any number that updates.
Do cap dynamic type at 1.6 times for text and 1.2 times for hull-scale numerals, and let hull numerals shrink to fit.
Do keep every touch target at least 48 points and slab buttons at least 56 tall.
Do mark state by stepping a neutral tone (Surface to Raised Surface) or by swapping fill and outline.
Do move things sideways, from the side of the team they belong to, in 200 to 220 ms with an exponential ease-out, and skip the movement under Reduce Motion.
Do keep text fields and the sheet panel rectangular.
donts: Don't print a team colour as text on the ground or on a neutral surface; it is only legible as text on a Graphite Ink fill.
Don't round a corner. No radius exists in this system.
Don't use a skew transform to lean a shape; Android will not render it.
Don't skew or rotate content inside a leaning shape. The shape leans; the italic does the rest.
Don't add shadows, gradients or blur to slabs, rows, chips, liveries, fields or sheets.
Don't invert the ink on team colours in the day appearance.
Don't use Danger for anything other than an invalid field and its message.
Don't add a second ornament alongside the triple-slash mark.
Don't give a utility icon a team colour.
